select count(*)from tb_user where 1=1
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')

select ifnull(sum(money),0) from pay_details where `state`=1
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')

select count(*) from tb_user t where 1=1
and date_format(t.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(t.create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(t.create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')

SELECT u.`user_name` as userName, u.avatar, u.user_id as userId, a.examine_time AS examineTime, a.status, (SELECT ifnull(SUM(money), 0) FROM user_money_details d WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} and d.relation_id = u.user_id) AS money FROM tb_user u left join agent_auth a on u.user_id = a.user_id
WHERE u.`inviter_code` = #{invitationCode} ORDER BY money DESC
SELECT u.* FROM tb_user u, industry_news_like l WHERE u.user_id = l.user_id AND l.news_id = #{newsId} order by l.create_time desc

select count(*) from tb_user u where u.staff_inviter_code = #{staffInvitationCode}
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as dayStr, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM tb_user WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND #{endDate} >= create_time GROUP BY dayStr ORDER BY dayStr ASC

select count(*) from tb_user where platform = #{platform}
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')
